evidence.detail: The class directly extends R436 CustomInterfaceBuilder and exact-v308 reverse references show only itself plus the central custom-interface registry.
The screen contains exact banner '<img=209> Welcome back to SpawnPK! Limited Time Event <img=209>' and exact personalized placeholder 'Welcome back, Username!'.
Exact title/date text includes 'Solar Event: Summer 2026', 'Event expires on: @yel@' and 'May 15th, 2026'.
The same screen contains 'Your next daily reward: @yel@24h 0m 0s' and text stating that one of the displayed rewards is received for logging in daily.
Exact controls/literals include 'Play now', 'Select', 'Check out this year's latest holiday event!' and misc/login resource assets.

proposals.note: Exact-v308 seasonal-event welcome/login presentation identity. Event scheduling, reward eligibility and reward grant authority are not inferred.
